row.title: Ledger replay must fetch the evidence branch
row.body: A runner checks out main only, so ledger.rows read origin/loop-evidence from a ref that did not exist and replayed main's rows alone; items with three recorded passes held at '1 of 2' and the fleet pass closed nothing. LEDGER-FETCH-1: _branch_text fetches the branch once when the ref is missing; tests/foundation/test_ledger_publish.py clones main single-branch and asserts the earlier pass is replayed.

title: Ledger replay must fetch the evidence branch
